sources: Detonation Unit (6-star Arts Unit), skill 3 "Detonate: Imposing Champion": "When the wielder applies an Arts Burst, target enemy suffers Arts DMG Taken +{spell_damage_taken_up} for {duration}s." rmxlinux Json/SkillData sk_wpn_funnel_0008 passiveEventActions: abilityEvent 127 (the wielder applies an Arts Burst) → CreateBuff buff_wpn_funnel_0008_magic_damage_taken_up on the target (spell_damage_taken_up, duration, lv). BuffData: damageModifier CheckDamageTypeMask 92 (Heat, Electric, Cryo, Nature) with DamageScaleProcessor side 1 (the target's side: DMG Taken) NormalCalcZone; stackingType 1 priority lv (two wielders' copies don't add).

The main-attribute, Arts Intensity and secondary-attribute + second_attr_up lines (cardAttributeModifier) are in the stat panel; toggleBuffs names buff_wpn_passive_spirit_01, which has no BuffData file (inert). Created on the burst event, so the bursting hit itself doesn't have it. Ardelia never bursts (she inflicts nothing): it fits an operator whose own hits burst. docs/kit-batches/batch-4/chr_0025_ardelia.md W4–W5.

triggers.note: abilityEvent 127: any Arts Burst the wielder applies (no skill-type check).
